title: Representative NdFeB grades: exact supplier-sheet examples

classes.label: No H-family suffix
classes.explanation: Compare each individual Hcj value. Even grades in this group do not all have the same coercivity or catalog temperature.

classes.label: H coercivity class
classes.explanation: These selected sheets specify Hcj ≥ 1,353 kA/m; the catalog lists 120°C for these rows. This describes these supplier examples, not a rule for every manufacturer.

classes.label: SH coercivity class
classes.explanation: These selected sheets specify Hcj ≥ 1,592 kA/m; the catalog lists 150°C for these rows. Temperature capability still depends on the application.

classes.label: UH coercivity class
classes.explanation: These selected sheets specify Hcj ≥ 1,990 kA/m; the catalog lists 180°C for these rows. A higher class does not identify a unique Dy/Tb recipe.

caveats: The number after N broadly identifies an energy-product class; it does not establish a universal nominal value, pull force, composition, heavy-rare-earth content or application.
H, SH and UH indicate supplier coercivity classes that are related to thermal demagnetization resistance. Compare exact Hcj values and demagnetization curves rather than relying on suffixes alone.

Dy/Tb additions or grain-boundary diffusion can increase coercivity; a higher N number does not automatically require more Dy or Tb. Grain-boundary diffusion is a processing strategy, not an ingredient implied by every suffix.

Catalog temperature limits are application dependent and are separate from the Curie temperature. A datasheet's thermal-coefficient measurement interval is also not automatically a maximum safe operating temperature.
Copied min/nominal/max markers are printed specification values, not statistical quantiles or a probability distribution.
Supplier PDFs and live summary tables contain discrepancies. The raw quoted triples, exact source revisions and row-level quality flags are retained; do not silently convert or repair them.
Nominal in an individual sheet and typical in a summary catalog are distinct reported fields. Do not splice the latter into the former.
Dates are from printed revision codes. Upload directories and filename suffixes do not reliably identify the present PDF revision.
This comparison supplies no recipe for any grade and does not add grade-specific composition to the quantitative supply simulation.
renderingNotes: Plot the individual-sheet MGOe min-to-max interval and nominal marker; label the values quoted and show qualityFlags near a selected grade.
Show Hcj minimum as a second independent axis or card. Keep catalog temperatures in a separate source-labeled field.
Offer grouping by no suffix / H / SH / UH. Do not label all thirteen rows as higher number = better.
Treat kJPerM3 as source-quoted parallel data with discrepancy flags; do not make it a converted toggle claiming numerical equivalence.
Link every individual sheet and show its printed revision. For N42SH show Rev. 020821 — date ambiguous.
Never use the superseded N35H /2017/11/ PDF as N35H evidence.
